page.title: AI Stock Picker — Your shortlist, reviewed by AI
page.description: An open-source command-line tool to rank your stock candidates with AI, validate every selection, and keep a traceable record.
hero.title:
Your shortlist.
A second perspective.
hero.body: Bring your stock candidates. Let AI rank them. Get a checked result and a record of how it was made.
hero.start: Try it without an API key
demo.label: THE IDEA, AT A GLANCE
demo.rank.detail: Rank using the fields you provide
demo.note: A workflow illustration, not live data or a stock recommendation.
workflow.title: A small tool with a clear job.
workflow.body: It starts after you build a candidate pool. It does not fetch prices, backtest a strategy, or place orders.
workflow.input.title: Bring your candidates
workflow.input.body: Use a supported JSON or CSV file. Choose a signal date, selection count, and ranking style.
workflow.review.title: Get another perspective
workflow.review.body: DeepSeek handles A-shares. Gemini handles US stocks. The model can only choose from your pool.
workflow.check.title: Check before saving
workflow.check.body: Validate the structure, count, unique symbols, and explanations. Invalid responses are rejected.
workflow.record.title: Keep the record
workflow.record.body: Save the result alongside inputs, the exact prompt, sanitized requests, raw responses, and hashes.
start.title:
Start with a sample.
No key required.
start.body: Install Python 3.10–3.12 and uv, then paste these commands into your terminal.
start.note: The historical A-share sample has one candidate. A dry run checks the input and shows a plan summary. It does not read credentials, call a model, or save a result.

footer.limit: For research. Not investment advice. AI commentary is based on input fields and is not independently fact-checked. Traceable records do not establish strict historical timing or guarantee returns.
